The experimental Vulkan compute adaptation is generated by
experiments/neural/prepare_anime4k.py, retaining this source notice. It preserves
the trained RGB residual math and keeps source alpha separate. The original
file is retained for independent matrix-reference parsing and auditability.
This is a line-art-trained single-image model; it is not NVIDIA DLSS.
